name: Robustation
storyline:
The action takes place on Space Station 14, where most of the crew has gone insane and the station itself turned into chaotic and liminal non-Euclidean spaces.
The player assumes the role of Greytide, whose mission is to eliminate the entire crew.
summary: Robustation is a fast-paced top-down shooter in the roguelike genre, set in the deranged universe of Space Station 14. The game features a vast array of combat techniques and weapon combinations, which, coupled with diverse perks and arsenal, ensures high replayability.
